Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: What is the percentage of UI rate assigned to New Employers and how do we get UI rates?\nassistant: New employers are assigned a 3.4 percent UI rate for two to three years. To get your UI rate, you can visit Get My UI Rate, enter your employer payroll tax account number, and select Get My UI Rate. Also, payroll agents can get UI rates for multiple clients by logging into e-Services for Business and selecting More and then Submit a Bulk Rate Inquiry from the Other Actions Section. If you acquired a business with employees, you have the option of keeping the previous owner's UI tax rate.\nuser: I do not agree with my UI rate, I want to protest my UI rate, please.\nassistant: You can protest your UI rates from the DE 2088 or benefit charges on the DE 428T online or by mail. To protest your UI rate online, you can follow these steps:\n1. Log in to e-Services for Business.\n2. Select 'Show More' from the Account Management panel.\n3. Select 'Protest UI Rate'.\n4. Enter the required information and submit.\nAfter you submit this information, you will receive a confirmation number. \nIf you prefer to protest by mail, you can include your EDD employer payroll tax account number, the items you want to protest, the reason for protesting, and mail your written protest to: Employment Development DepartmentRate Management Group, MIC 4PO Box 826880Sacramento, CA 94280-0001. Please note that protests with missing or incorrect information will be returned.\nuser: what is Benefit Charges, please? Can I protest Benefit Charges as well?",
    "answer": "Benefit Charges 指记入雇主账户的失业保险福利费用。可以提出异议：在线登录 e-Services for Business，在 Account Management 面板选择 Show More，再选择 Protest Benefit Charges，填写并提交所需信息；需准备要申诉的 DE 428T 的 Letter ID。提交后会收到确认号码。也可以邮寄申诉，须提供雇主 EDD 工资税账户号码、每位申请人的姓名和社会安全号码、每项索赔日期、费用金额、具体申诉理由及申诉人数；信息缺失或错误的申诉会被退回。邮寄地址：Employment Development Department, Contribution Rate Group, MIC 4, PO Box 826831, Sacramento, CA 94230-6831。（根据第1页）"
}

statements: Benefit Charges 指记入雇主账户的失业保险福利费用。
雇主可以对 Benefit Charges 提出异议。
雇主可以通过 e-Services for Business 在线提交 Benefit Charges 申诉。
在线申诉的第一步是登录 e-Services for Business。
登录后，雇主需要在 Account Management 面板选择 Show More。
选择 Show More 后，雇主需要选择 Protest Benefit Charges。
选择 Protest Benefit Charges 后，雇主需要填写并提交申诉所需信息。
雇主需要准备拟申诉的 DE 428T 文件上的 Letter ID。
提交在线申诉后，雇主会收到确认号码。
雇主也可以通过邮寄方式提交 Benefit Charges 申诉。
邮寄申诉需要提供雇主的 EDD 工资税账户号码。
邮寄申诉需要提供每位申请人的姓名和社会安全号码。
邮寄申诉需要提供每项索赔的日期。
邮寄申诉需要提供费用金额。
邮寄申诉需要提供具体申诉理由。
邮寄申诉需要提供申诉人数。
信息缺失或错误的申诉会被退回。
Benefit Charges 申诉的邮寄地址为 Employment Development Department, Contribution Rate Group, MIC 4, PO Box 826831, Sacramento, CA 94230-6831。
答案中的信息依据所引用资料的第1页。
